items.text: Only got two hours in and that was enough for me, seems pretty buggy. Saved a game to go have lunch, when I got back, no save game, had to start all over again. Went to sell scrap and was told I couldn't, but somehow the items I was carrying disappeared anyway. Been caught several times unable to exit the game, almost no keys working, can't get up the settings/exit menu at all.
items.text_zh: 只玩了两小时，对我来说就够了，似乎漏洞挺多。保存了游戏去吃午饭，回来后，存档没了，只好从头再来。去卖废料，却被告知不能卖，但不知怎么的，我携带的物品还是消失了。好几次被困住无法退出游戏，几乎什么键都不管用，根本调不出设置/退出菜单。

observations.description: 无法出售废料但物品却消失了
observations.evidence: Went to sell scrap and was told I couldn't, but somehow the items I was carrying disappeared anyway
